description: Saved results that regenerate the paper's figures and tables. Each file lists its source in the original experiment tree, the source's SHA-256, and how it was derived (renames and dropped fields only; every kept value is exact).

benchmark_windows.npz.backs: Fig. 2; detector scores and labels for router evaluation (1,999 videos, 72,287 windows)
benchmark_windows.npz.derivation: kept labels, detector scores and the (action, margin) of the 7 Fig. 2 methods; renamed gate->unbudgeted_gate, uniform_cycle->uniform; values exact

budget_curves/seed0.json.backs: Fig. 3; text: 2.6 pp to the oracle, >96 % of the oracle, 6.6-8.1 pp over single detectors
budget_curves/seed0.json.derivation: detector-scored accuracy per budget, final router (stage 1 + 2); kept the 7 plotted methods and 4 metrics; renamed causal->router, uniform_cycle->uniform, multimodal_only->multimodal; values exact
